judge.rationale: The candidate appear to have stopped after the red phase of TDD: it wrote `.lore/dod.md`, added a failing acceptance test in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.onError.acceptance.test.ts`, and added a line to `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, but never actually edited `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to implement the fix. As a result, the new acceptance test fails because `chatOrchestrator.ts` still gates `onError` on `error instanceof Error`. Furthermore, the candidate did not remove the old 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section from `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` (creating a contradiction in the spec), did not update `CHANGELOG.md`, and put the test in a separate `.acceptance.test.ts` file rather than `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
